name: keys
title: Keys
description: Estate-agent listings on clean white and agency-board green: every property card flies a corner status flag in one of three colours — open, pending or closed, for sales, lets and stays alike — with the price first and biggest and a ruled row of figures beneath, the phone number in the masthead and an inquiry box on every page.

tokens.--font-body: all text — a plain system sans, nothing showy
tokens.--text-xs: status flags and small uppercase labels
tokens.--text-s: small text: addresses, hours, the figures row on a card, the footer
tokens.--text-l: the agency name, the intro line under a page title, small headings
tokens.--text-xl: the property title, the inquiry heading, section headings
tokens.--text-xxl: page titles and the price on a property page
tokens.--text-price: the price on a listing card — the biggest thing on it
tokens.--leading-tight: line spacing of headings and prices
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter spacing of uppercase labels and flags
tokens.--tracking-tight: letter spacing of headings and prices (slightly tightened)
tokens.--color-bg: page background — clean white with a warm cast
tokens.--color-accent: agency-board green — the name plate, links, buttons, focus rings
tokens.--color-accent-ink: text placed on the accent color (name plate, main button)
tokens.--color-flag-sale: the flag and top edge of an open listing — For sale, To let, Available
tokens.--color-flag-offer: the flag and top edge of a pending listing — Under offer, Let agreed (amber)
tokens.--color-flag-sold: the flag and top edge of a closed listing — Sold, Booked (slate)
tokens.--color-photo-blank: ground behind a photo while it loads
tokens.--color-tint: green-tinted fill of the inquiry box
tokens.--measure: maximum width of a text column
tokens.--space-1: smallest spacing step; also the thickness of the coloured edge on a card
tokens.--card-ratio: shape of photos as width divided by height: 1.3333 is 4:3, 1.7778 is 16:9
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of cards and the inquiry box
tokens.--radius-s: small rounding: name plate, buttons, photos, code
tokens.--tap-target: minimum touch height of buttons and menu links
